name: masar
description: A local-first Kanban desktop app with optional premium sync.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && tsx scripts/e2e-reset.ts && playwright test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.desktop:compile: esbuild desktop/src/main.ts desktop/src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outdir=desktop/dist && esbuild src/server/entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:libsql --outfile=desktop/dist/server.js && esbuild desktop/src/migrate-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:libsql --outfile=desktop/dist/migrate.js
scripts.desktop:build:mac: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && cross-env MASAR_TARGETS=darwin-arm64,darwin-x64 npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --mac
scripts.desktop:build:win: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && cross-env MASAR_TARGETS=win32-x64-msvc npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --win
scripts.desktop:build:linux: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && cross-env MASAR_TARGETS=linux-x64-gnu,linux-x64-musl,linux-arm64-gnu,linux-arm64-musl npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --linux
